<thought>Using the ESI‑MS spectrum, the base peak at m/z 211.0764 corresponds to the [M+H]⁺ ion. Subtracting the mass of a proton gives a neutral molecular mass of ≈210.069 Da. The isotopic pattern (M+2 ≈ 33 % of M) indicates the presence of one chlorine atom. Removing the exact mass of ³⁵Cl (34.968852 Da) leaves 175.100 Da to be accounted for by C, H, O, and N. The combination C₁₁H₁₃NO matches this residual mass within < 1 mDa. Therefore the molecular formula of the compound is C₁₁H₁₃ClNO.</thought>
<final_answer>C11H13ClNO</final_answer>
